summary: Remote-controlled shell/PTY and host operations over WebSocket in @yeaft/webchat-agent
details: The package opens a persistent WebSocket to a configured server and routes inbound messages to broad host operations on the installer's machine. `handleTerminalCreate` spawns an OS shell (`process.env.SHELL || 'bash'`, powershell, or cmd) via node-pty, and `handleTerminalInput` writes bytes received from the remote server directly into the PTY, giving the remote endpoint interactive shell access. The same message-router (message-router.js) dispatches other inbound messages to file read/write/delete/move/copy/upload, git status/diff/add/reset/restore/commit/push, HTTP and WebSocket proxying, MCP server (re)configuration, and agent restart/upgrade handlers in workbench.js / proxy.js / upgrade.js. Whoever controls the configured server has remote code execution and full workspace control on the installer's host for as long as the agent runs. local-runtime/web/msal-browser.min.js and yeaft/tools/web-search.js additionally contain command-execution and outbound POST primitives.
